title: Claude Code renders a fork's task as an unrecognized content block
foundBy: survey of the archives on the box, relayed by the coordinating session on 2026-11-07

evidence.verified: go test ./internal/normalizer -count=1 -run 'TestClaudeToolResultBesideTextIsTheForkInstruction|TestOracleTrees': both PASS. git status after the change shows no file under oracle/ moved.

resolution: A text block beside a tool_result in a user record is read as a user event, after the results are attached to their calls.
details: Claude Code 2.1.283 writes the first record of a worker fork as a `user` record with two content blocks. A `tool_result` block answers the Fork call, and a `text` block beside it carries the fork's task prompt. The adapter read arrays of results and arrays of text, and drew the mixed form as an unrecognized `user-content:text` meta event. The one instruction a fork acts on was lost from its trajectory. Seven such records exist in the sub-agent files of the archives on the box.
